title: PicoFBT
description: Pico Full Body Tracking support for QuestCraft
body:
# PicoFBT - Full Body Tracking for QuestCraft
**Bring your whole body into Minecraft VR! PicoFBT adds native support for Pico Motion Trackers to QuestCraft, enabling full-body tracking with up to 7 tracking points (waist, feet, elbows, and knees).**

## Features:
- **Native Pico Tracker Support** - Seamlessly integrates with Pico Motion Trackers on your Pico 4, 4 Ultra, or Neo 3 headset
- **Auto-Calibration** - Hold a T-pose in the calibration screen for 3 seconds and you're ready to go
- **Low Latency** - Built on Pico's native body tracking API for responsive, real-time movement
- **Pico-Optimized** - Specifically designed for standalone VR on Pico headsets running QuestCraft

## Requirements:
- QuestCraft (Minecraft 1.21.1 with Vivecraft)
- Pico 4, Pico 4 Ultra, or Pico Neo 3 headset
- Pico Motion Trackers (minimum 2 trackers - Pico will estimate additional tracking points)

## How to Use:
- Install the mod JAR into your QuestCraft mods folder, or install it from the mod manager
- Pair your Pico Motion Trackers
- Launch Minecraft VR
- Open Settings → Calibrate FBT...
- Stand in a T-pose with all trackers visible for 3 seconds
- Enjoy full-body immersion in Minecraft!
Transform your Minecraft VR experience from a floating torso to a fully-tracked avatar. Dance, crouch, kick, and move naturally in your blocky world!
